perspective:
RECOMMENDER’s available information:

- Seeker greeted RECOMMENDER and asked for recommendations of good classic movies.
- RECOMMENDER asked whether “classic” meant before or after the 70s.
- Seeker said “After.”
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Indecent Proposal* (1993), mentioning Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson.
- Seeker rejected it as “too risque.”
- RECOMMENDER suggested *Sleepless in Seattle* (1993), mentioning Hanks and Ryan.
- Seeker said that was more his speed, though it had been a while since he’d seen it.
- RECOMMENDER said that was okay and nothing was wrong with that.
- RECOMMENDER asked if Seeker had seen *All the Right Moves* (1983) with Tom Cruise.
- Seeker said he hadn’t and asked if it was good.
- RECOMMENDER said yes, and told Seeker that if he liked *Ferris Bueller’s Day Off* (1986), he’d like *All the Right Moves*.
- RECOMMENDER then asked about *Days of Thunder* (1990).
- Seeker said he’d never seen that either.
- RECOMMENDER told Seeker it was a really great film, that he’d love it, and compared it to *Regarding Henry* (1991) but with race cars.
- Seeker said it sounded good, thanked RECOMMENDER for the suggestions, and said he was going to check which ones were on Netflix to watch later today.
